text: Heather was the perfect addition to our wedding day! She was able to capture our day in a painting that we can cherish for years to come. Every time I look at the painting I am transported back to that day! Heather is such a professional she set up a call with us beforehand and created a sketch of what we had in mind. She sent us some progress pictures and we were able to make adjustments before the painted was finished. All of our guests at the wedding loved watching Heather paint throughout the night.

owner_reply.text: Thank you so much Gabby!! It means so much to me you had me come paint at your wedding!! 💗🌸💗
